en.title: The Rothschild banking houses: sovereign bonds, information networks, European infrastructure and the limits of dynastic power
en.deck: Historical institutional study of Mayer Amschel and the five banking houses, public debt placement, war payments, rail finance, philanthropy and conspiracy claims tested against archives.
keywords: The Rothschild banking houses: sovereign bonds, information networks, European infrastructure and the limits of dynastic power
en.regime: Banking and public institutions developed across changing political regimes.
en.key_risk: Conflating banking contracts with legally unlimited control of states.
en.search_text: The Rothschild banking houses: sovereign bonds, information networks, European infrastructure and the limits of dynastic power
